title: Protégé
name: Evander
description: The Protégé is a brilliant young scholar burning himself out on a single idea. He has stopped eating properly, stopped sleeping properly and stopped answering most letters, and the walls of his home are covered in the calculations he calls his Body of Work, a framework for remaking reality itself. Somewhere beneath the obsession is the bright, eager student his mentor remembers, and he is getting harder to find.
history: The Protégé was the brightest student the University had seen in years, and it was he who first found the Iron Crown. He chafed at his mentor's insistence on secrecy, and when the library burned with their research inside, he was furious where the Academic was relieved. The failed ritual at the Ancestor's manor only proved to him that the Crown could be made to work. He left the University and carried on his experiments in his mentor's study, until even the Academic's reluctance became too much, and went home to his childhood house in the Valley to finish his Body of Work alone.
summary: A brilliant and obsessive Protégé, alone in his childhood home, working to remake reality through his Body of Work.

appearance.height: Average, though often hunched over his work
appearance.build: Once fit, now gaunt from self-neglect
appearance.hairColor: Dark, with premature streaks of grey
appearance.features: Piercing eyes with dark circles beneath, ink-stained fingers, occasional tremors

clothing.head: None
clothing.body: Once-fine shirt now stained with ink and chemicals
clothing.legs: Scholar's trousers worn thin at the knees

notes: Has no patience for anyone slower than himself and bristles at being told to wait, which cost him every friend he had at the University
Is courteous but absent in company, answering a beat late as if called back from somewhere else, and comes alive only when his work is discussed
Talks quickly and in fragments when thinking aloud, hardly at all with most people, and eagerly and well with anyone he considers an equal
